text:
Samira (CSM): kicking off weekly Vela private deploy health check — quick region-by-region snapshot pls :wave:
Jon (Solutions Eng): US-West: traffic +12% w/w, p50 latency 68ms, p95 210ms. No errors >10k reqs.
Ravi (Platform SRE): EU-West: throughput flat, p95 spiked to 420ms yesterday 03:12 UTC during a cache miss window. Uptime 99.1% for last 7 days.
Elena (Account Exec): AP-Southeast: customer reported two KMS failures 2024-11-27 08:14 & 09:03 local. They saw 503s for ~90s each time. Renewal flag? they asked about HSM SLAs.
Samira (CSM): noted. onboarding still in phase 2, heavy sync jobs start this week so expect more burst. Renewal at EOM - flagging as "needs eng review" until KMS root cause known.
Ravi (Platform SRE): digging into KMS logs now. Quick paste of error pattern:
```
Nov 27 08:14:22 kms-proxy[pid=2312]: ERROR: unable to decrypt key id=urn:kb:vela:12345 code=14 timeout
Nov 27 08:14:23 svc-proxy[pid=4411]: 503 POST /v1/infer  (latency=1023ms)
Nov 27 09:03:05 kms-proxy[pid=2320]: ERROR: transient auth failure, retry 1
```
Jon (Solutions Eng): can we confirm whether proxy retried to external KMS endpoint or local HSM? Need to know if network flake or KMS side.
Ravi (Platform SRE): looks like egress to KMS region ap-southeast-1 had packet loss around those minutes — tcp retransmits high. Running `mtr -r -c 100 kms.ap-southeast-1.example` from bastion to confirm.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary rollout to vela-private/ap-southeast completed: 2/2 instances healthy :white_check_mark:
Elena (Account Exec): spend note: they're at 78% of committed Dedicated spend; weekly ramping means we may hit commit by renewal if bursts continue.
Samira (CSM): risk scoring: currently MEDIUM — reasons: KMS flakiness + ramping spend. Next actions: 1) Ravi to confirm root cause (network vs KMS). 2) Jon to draft mitigation (local cache TTL increase, fallback to cached wrapped keys). 3) Samira to schedule a technical enablement call Wed 14:00 PT with Vela ops.
Ravi (Platform SRE): quick mitigation deployed: increased KMS client retry backoff and enabled local KV cache for wrapped keys for 30s. Monitor logs for regressions.
Jon (Solutions Eng): proposed config snippet for customers to reduce impact:
```
kms_client:
  retry_policy:
    max_attempts: 6
    base_backoff_ms: 200
    max_backoff_ms: 2000
local_wrap_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 30
```
Samira (CSM): capture of customer feedback: they want clearer HSM SLA and a playbook for KMS fallbacks. Adding to enablement deck + ops runbook.
Elena (Account Exec): I'll surface SLA ask to sales/legal. Also scheduling renewal prep call for 1 week before EOM.
Ravi (Platform SRE): monitoring notes: setting alert threshold — if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 10m in any region, escalate to oncall and CSM.
Samira (CSM): any objections? :eyes:
Jon (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: looks good. Will add a short note to docs and send PR for config example.
Ravi (Platform SRE): followups: pushing KMS tracer spans to tracing dashboard, will share link once populated.
Samira (CSM): tl;dr summary for thread — AP-Southeast had transient KMS connectivity causing short 503 blips; mitigations applied (retries + local cache); monitoring/alerts tightened; renewal flagged as medium risk due to spend + KMS ask; enablement call scheduled Wed 14:00 PT. Owners: Ravi (root cause), Jon (mitigation docs), Samira (customer comms + enablement).
Elena (Account Exec): thanks team. I'll join the enablement call and prep renewal materials.
Samira (CSM): thanks all — will post follow-up with the tracing dashboard link and meeting invite. :calendar:
